I answered from the docs that AGENTS.md routes inventory questions to. I didn't open the code, so the line numbers are the docs' anchors and may have drifted.

**Where it opens**
- The Inventory button is at `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html:9`.
- It calls `openInventory()` at `game-console.component.ts:237`.
- That calls `MatDialog.open(InventoryComponent, { data, panelClass: 'inv-dialog-panel', maxHeight: '90vh' })` at `:242`.
- The dialog appears at the bottom of the page rather than centered, because `styles.scss` lacks `mat.core()` (B-14).

**Data passed**
- The data is `InventoryDialogData = { characterId, sessionId }`, defined at `inventory/inventory.component.ts:19`.
- `InventoryComponent` receives it through `MAT_DIALOG_DATA`.

**API calls it can make**
All calls go through `GameApiService` (`game-api.service.ts`).

| Action | Method | Endpoint | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Load on init (`ngOnInit`, `:53`) | `getInventory` (`:90`) | `GET /api/character/:id` (`worker/src/routes/character.ts:72`) | The result is copied into `CharacterStateService.setInventory`. |
| Equip/unequip (`toggleEquip`, `:72`) | `equipItem` (`:96`) | `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip` (`character.ts:93`) | Equipping a weapon or armor unequips others of the same type. It is display only, because combat ignores equipment (B-08). |
| Drop (`dropItem`, `:144`) | `dropItem` (`:100`) | `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` (`character.ts:137`) | It asks `confirm()` first, then removes one unit. |
| Use potion (`usePotion`, `:96`) | `dropItem` (same DELETE) | `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` | The heal dice are rolled in the browser. HP is set locally only and never saved (B-05). |

The dialog does not call the shop endpoints (`GET /api/shop/:id` and `POST /api/shop/transaction`). Those exist only in the Worker and have no UI yet.
